records.notes: A.1 item 17 (14.9.4.4 GR3 h) 2.): required, documented in docs/CONFORMANCE.md DOC-A.1-17: none beyond the transfer of control. cite.py --check 14.9.4.4 'All other effects of the CALL statement are defined by the implementor.' -> OK 3) h) 2. The two goldens drive every condition GR3 h) 2. reaches for a CALL, each handled by a USE AFTER EXCEPTION declarative ending RESUME AT NEXT STATEMENT, with a successful CALL as control (the callee stores into the USING and RETURNING items and NOT ON EXCEPTION runs): EC-PROGRAM-NOT-FOUND, -PTR-NULL (a NULL program-pointer), -ARG-MISMATCH (one argument against two required formals, checking enabled in both separate programs), -RESOURCES (a recursive program run out of its activation's stack reserve, DOC-A.1-14), -RECURSIVE-CALL (a callee calling the active non-recursive caller) and, at 2023 only, EC-EXTERNAL-FORMAT-CONFLICT (an EXTERNAL item PIC 9(4) against PIC X(6), checking enabled in both). In every arm the callee does not run, the USING argument keeps its value and so does the RETURNING item where the CALL has one (every arm but RESOURCES), NOT ON EXCEPTION is not executed, and FUNCTION EXCEPTION-STATUS names the condition, still after a later successful CALL returns (the last exception status is the run unit's, cite.py --check 14.6.13.1.1 'a last exception status exists for the entire run unit' -> OK). The PARTIAL of 2026-09-24 held the ARG-MISMATCH and EC-EXTERNAL arms unprobed: its probe (a nested callee, LINKAGE X(10) called with X(4)) raised no mismatch. Re-probed 2026-11-05 at ab64e9cf7, that nested call and a nested argument-count mismatch both raise EC-PROGRAM-ARG-MISMATCH, and the goldens reach both arms. The abnormal-termination half (a declarative without RESUME, §14.6.3 3)) is pinned by ExceptionConditionConformanceTests.CallFails_Enabled_DeclarativeWithoutResume_FatalTerminates (NOT-FOUND, PTR-NULL, ARG-MISMATCH). Found while probing: a formal passed on BY REFERENCE through every recursion level crashes the RESOURCES arm with a .NET stack overflow (kb/Work PB4768); the golden passes each level's own LOCAL-STORAGE item. Owning note: A11.
